examples.title: Text Input with Error
examples.code:
<Stack direction="vertical" gap="xs">
  <Label htmlFor="email">Email</Label>
  <Textfield 
    id="email"
    data-size="medium"
    placeholder="Enter email"
    error="Invalid email address"
    aria-invalid="true"
    aria-describedby="email-error"
  />
  <Text id="email-error" variant="caption" size="xs" role="alert" style={{ color: 'var(--ds-color-danger-text-default)' }}>
    Invalid email address
  </Text>
</Stack>
